content.title: Red-Black Character Type Carousel | Mirrored Gestures and Terminal Gate
content.summary: An adult courier crosses mirrored hand-and-word modules before recombining at an orange terminal gate. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original character retains at least three identity anchors across every graphic module. + Each module follows one visible body action and introduces no more than one exact short word. + Mirroring and duplication preserve face, wardrobe and orientation rather than creating unrelated identities. + Module density may rise, but recurring palette, hand motif and circular geometry remain traceable. + The final gate recombines duplicates and returns the complete character under one exact original title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult male night courier with white hair, a charcoal long coat, one orange glove and a triangular cheek mark inside a navy-cream-orange graphic system. A forward step duplicates the courier into three registered panels marked only "WAIT", each retaining the same face, coat and cheek mark. He stops alone at an orange gate beneath the exact original title "LAST ROUTE", with palette, glove and route circle visible together.
required_anchors: One clearly adult original character retains at least three identity anchors across every graphic module.
Each module follows one visible body action and introduces no more than one exact short word.
Module density may rise, but recurring palette, hand motif and circular geometry remain traceable.
The final gate recombines duplicates and returns the complete character under one exact original title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult courier crosses mirrored hand-and-word modules before recombining at an orange terminal gate. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年原创动画角色，用手势、转身和奔跑触发赤黑白字卡、镜像手掌与对称几何；单人与复制模块交替升级，最终让完整角色抵达一扇可读终门。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original character retains at least three identity anchors across every graphic module.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original character retains at least three identity anchors across every graphic module."

invariants.rule: Each module follows one visible body action and introduces no more than one exact short word.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each module follows one visible body action and introduces no more than one exact short word."

invariants.rule: Mirroring and duplication preserve face, wardrobe and orientation rather than creating unrelated identities.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Mirroring and duplication preserve face, wardrobe and orientation rather than creating unrelated identities."

invariants.rule: Module density may rise, but recurring palette, hand motif and circular geometry remain traceable.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Module density may rise, but recurring palette, hand motif and circular geometry remain traceable."

invariants.rule: The final gate recombines duplicates and returns the complete character under one exact original title.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final gate recombines duplicates and returns the complete character under one exact original title."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
